newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Marlin to acquire 56 pct of Kudu.
newsitem.headline: Marlin to acquire 56 pct of Kudu.

text.p: Marlin Corp Ltd and Anglo American Corp of South Africa said in a joint statement on Thursday that Marlin would acquire 56 percent of Kudu Granite Holdings Ltd from Deutsche Steinindustrie AG.

They said the acquisition saw Marlin's ultimate holding compay, IIE S.a.R.L., buying Deutsche Steinindustrie AG's (Destag) southern African assets which included its 56 percent stake in and loans to Kudu and its subsidiaries.
IIE would also buy a 33.3 percent stake in Natural Stone processors.
The price tag for the entire transaction was 50 million rand, the companies said.
Included in the 50 million rand purchase price is the consideration for the Kudu shares sold by Destag, amounting to 100 cents a Kudu share.

IIE, which is an unlisted Luxembourg-based company, intends to inject the assets bought from Destag into the Marlin group, a move to be funded by way of rights issues. The cash raised will be used to reduce the high level of debt in Kudu.
In terms of the transaction, Anglo's 28 percent holding in Destag will be cancelled via a capital reduction with the balance of the purchase price to be paid in cash by IIE.

The value owed to Anglo as a result of the capital reduction will be met via the issue to Anglo of a 30 percent stake in IIE, which at present equates to an approximate eight percent interest in Marlin.
IIE owns 52 percent of Marlin Holdings Ltd, which in turn owns 50.3 percent of Marlin.

The inclusion of Kudu's operations in Marlin would increase production in its key Rustenburg granite products from 30,000 cubic metres to over 80,000 per annum, which represents some 50 percent of the total Rustenburg production.
The combined total production of the expanded Marlin group would make it one of the world's largest producers of dimensional stone.
The statement said an offer by Marlin to Kudu minorites would be made at the acquisition price.
In a separate transaction Mondial Granit S.A.R.L., in which Marlin is a one third shareholder, has bought Destag's French distributing company SFD for 1.25 million marks.
The entire transation is dependent on the registration of the necessary resolutions by the Local German Court by no later than January 31, 1997.
